summary: Phase 9C round 5 (Batch C) — 7 new router extractions (billing, invoice, imports, vendors, projects, auth, po_exports) verified regression-clean. New pytest suite test_phase9c_r5_batch_c.py (56 tests, ~2.7s) covers every extracted endpoint: RBAC, request-body validation, master-audit reason-required guards, Excel/PDF stream correctness, GST CGST/SGST/IGST split for intra vs inter-state vendors, DC audit fix verification, and OpenAPI presence for all 33 required paths. Combined with the previous three suites = 160/160 pytest pass in ~7.2s. LLM UAT exit=0 (0 failures). DC audit fix verified — new_value.status now correctly reports 'pending_approval' instead of hardcoded 'issued'.

P0_auth.dev_login: 400 on missing email; 400 on invalid role; 200 issues token, upserts user, canonicalises role
P0_auth.set_role: 403 non-admin; 400 invalid role; 404 user not found

P0_vendors.update_reason_required: no reason → 400; with reason → 200 + name persisted

P0_projects.list_scoping: admin sees all; purchase/gm/director count matches admin; pm-scoped list only shows projects where user_id in project_managers

P0_po_exports.po_pdf_token_query: ?token= supports browser download without Bearer header

P0_dc_audit_fix.verification: POST /api/dc as purchase creates DC with status='pending_approval'. GET /api/audit?entity=dc&entity_id={id} returns create-row with details.new_value.status='pending_approval' — bug in routers/dc.py:88 confirmed fixed.

P1_cross_router.happy_path: MRF create (admin) → submit → approve (with action=approve body) → send-to-purchase → PO create (purchase, ₹100 auto-issued) → GET /api/po/{id}/pdf?force=1 via po_exports router → 200 %PDF. Full happy-path executes end-to-end.

coverage_matrix.rbac_drift_check: None. Billing={purchase,admin,director}, Invoice={purchase,director,admin}, Vendors mutations={admin,purchase,director}, Projects admin-only for mutations with pm/siteeng/store scoped reads, Imports vendors={admin,purchase} and mrf={admin,site_engineer,pm,director}, PO exports bulk denies site_engineer/store — all preserved byte-identical from server.py.
coverage_matrix.dc_audit_fix_verification: Verified via GET /api/audit?entity=dc&entity_id={dc_id}. details.new_value.status now equals dc.status default 'pending_approval'. Previous hardcoded 'issued' is gone — iteration 25 minor issue resolved.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1735 — Down from 5276 (67% total reduction across Batches A/B/C). Now well under the 700-line threshold for the trailing helpers-only region if further split. Router-import side-effects still rely on server.py registering routers AFTER defining all shared symbols (from server import ...). Order-fragile but functional.

routers/po_exports.py:73 — _validate_po_for_export currently blocks export on missing mandatory data. `?force=1` correctly bypasses. Tests use `?force=1` on the ₹100 test PO because the seeded vendors have `gstin='27AAAAA0000A1Z1'` which passes but customer_id may be blank. Confirmed 200 in every dispatcher path.

routers/imports.py:73 — MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES hoist to server.py top-level works. 5MB+1 rejected with 413 in ~15ms server-side (rejects after file.read()). For very large uploads consider chunked SpooledTemporaryFile pattern later.

routers/vendors.py:27 — Documented 403 role list says {'admin','purchase','director'} but review request stated 'pm/gm/site_engineer/store' should get 403 — the actual gate PASSES those roles (all four get 403). No drift.

routers/projects.py:37 — `store` role gets identical scoping to `site_engineer` (project-level or per-site membership). Correct per spec but worth calling out that store == siteeng for project visibility.
